description: On the bed in front of you there’s a black power strip with a cord leading left, and a small white USB adapter/dongle connected by a short cable. The left hand reaches in from the left and the right hand from the right to the power strip; the left hand lifts and angles the white USB adapter near a port while the right hand steadies the strip as the connector is worked loose, then the left hand pulls the USB plug out and lowers it onto the bed, leaving the power strip in the right hand.
